page_title: RMA 2-0 RSO | Real Madrid v Real Sociedad 24/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+2' That's the end of the match.
90' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
87' We are about to witness a substitution. Chema Andres (Real Madrid) is replacing Luka Modric.
84' Imanol Alguacil has decided to substitute Luka Sucic and he is replaced by Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad).

83' 2 - 0 Vinicius Junior is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot which bounces in off the bottom of the left post to make the score 2:0.
82' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Real Madrid have a corner.
80' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
80' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom right corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save! Real Madrid get a corner.
79' Mario Melero interrupts the game. One of the players from Real Sociedad won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Real Madrid are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
77' Lucas Vazquez goes off the pitch and Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid) comes on.
75' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
71' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Sociedad.
71' Imanol Alguacil has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) replacing Sergio Gomez.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) replaces Arkaitz Mariezkurrena.
70' Here's the change. Benat Turrientes leaves the pitch and Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) comes on as a substitute.
70' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
68' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
67' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
67' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes the corner with a short pass.
66' The ball is out of play. Real Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner.

66' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
65' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Luka Modric (Real Madrid), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
64' The ball is cleared after Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.

63' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Unai Marrero pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.

62' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
61' Real Sociedad are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
56' Here is a change. Aurelien Tchouameni is going off and Carlo Ancelotti gives the last tactical orders to Jesus Vallejo (Real Madrid).
55' Brahim Diaz doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) comes onto the pitch to replace him.
53' Real Sociedad earn a corner.

52' A loose ball is pounced on by Arkaitz Mariezkurrena (Real Sociedad) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Andriy Lunin is alert and makes a comfortable save. It will be a corner kick for Real Sociedad.
51' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
51' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
49' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
48' A player from Real Sociedad pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. Real Madrid get a free kick.
48' The attendance for today's match is 73186.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Imanol Alguacil probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad). He is replaced by Jon Ander Olasagasti.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.

45+1' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) leaps like a salmon and powers a header in at goal from the corner, but his close-range effort is poor and goes way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
45+1' The referee awards a corner and Arda Guler (Real Madrid) goes over to take it.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' A clumsy foul by Luka Modric (Real Madrid) and Mario Melero blows his whistle. Real Sociedad will take a free kick near the side line.
43' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) works the corner short.
42' Real Sociedad take a short corner kick.
41' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The ball goes out of play. Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
38' 1 - 0 Goal! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:0.
38' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the bottom left corner, but Unai Marrero leaps out to thwart his attempt.
38' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is going to take the penalty!
38' The Real Madrid players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
38' There's a break in play and referee Mario Melero must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Real Madrid using VAR. This could be interesting!

37' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the roof of the net, but Unai Marrero shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. Corner kick. Real Madrid will have an opportunity.
36' Surely that's handball by one of the Real Sociedad players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
36' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes the corner which is cleared.
35' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Good work from Real Madrid as they win a corner.

34' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but his shot missed the target close to the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
32' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
31' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
30' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
28' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
27' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) prepares to take a corner kick.
26' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
24' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
23' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
23' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
22' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
20' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
19' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
18' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
17' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
16' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Real Sociedad, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
15' A player from Real Madrid commits a rough challenge. Mario Melero blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Real Sociedad are awarded the free kick.

13' A clever short pass gives Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.

11' Real Madrid are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
7' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
7' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

7' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Unai Marrero guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The referee points to the corner flag and Real Madrid will take a corner.
6' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
4' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
4' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
3' An attempted cross from Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) is cleared.
2' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Real Madrid will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Mario Melero.
